title: Counted In
summary: Old Brannagh counted the night shift out. She wants them counted in. A lamp off the Last Flame, carried down to the Cinderworks' pens, and held there.

steps.journal: The Cinderworks, the first floor or below: hold six waves with the Flame's lamp lit.

ready: The Flame's lamp burned in the Cinderworks the whole time. Tell Old Brannagh.
done: Brannagh has her count. It's short. She wrote down the difference too.
